His premiership also coincided with the heights of the Troubles in Northern Ireland. | Conservative | | 1976-79 | James Callaghan – With inflation running at 17% and 1.5 million unemployed, Callaghan made the controversial decision to ask the IMF for an emergency loan. After having draft versions of her EU withdrawal agreement rejected by parliament on three occasions, May resigned. | Conservative | | 2019-19 | Alexander Boris Johnson – Following the resignation of Theresa May, Johnson was elected leader of the Conservative Party and appointed prime minister.
